title: plan_ops__parse_plan_review_report input
description: Validate a Phase 1.5 plan-review envelope against codex_plan_review_schema.json; surface verdict + findings. Default input is the Codex wrapper envelope; with --from-claude, stdin is the bare `parsed` payload emitted by the Phase 1.5-Claude `plan-reviewer` Agent.

from_claude.description: Parse the bare `parsed` payload (Phase 1.5-Claude path) instead of the Codex wrapper envelope. Skips the envelope-level `subcommand`/`outcome`/`task_id` checks and validates stdin directly against codex_plan_review_schema.json.

payload.description: Payload formerly delivered via --stdin; carries the JSON envelope body.
